newsitem.title: UK: EMS/Mark edges lower on crosses, stg/mark weighs.
newsitem.headline: EMS/Mark edges lower on crosses, stg/mark weighs.

text.p: 0730 GMT - Mark edges lower on crosses, weighed down by strength in sterling/mark hovering just below 59-mth highs.
* Lira firm after Italy cuts discount and Lombard rates by 50 bps to 6.25 and 7.75 pct respectively late Friday.
* Italy treasury minister Ciampi says rate cut brings Italy EMU membership closer though warns against over-optimism, says sees continued trend for lower rates.
* Italy Q1 GDP -0.2 pct q/q and -0.4 y/y vs forecast -0.3 and -0.5. Mark/lira at 976.55/85, off earlier low but below 977.40/60 seen late Friday before rate cut.
* French May s/a jobless numbers +1.1 pct m/m. Unemployment rate unchanged 12.5 pct. Mark/Paris at 3.3710/16 vs 3.3727/30.
* Buba's Tietmeyer says hopes Germany can meet deficit/GDP target, but says sustainable budget discipline more important than hitting targets.
